name: Block Lottos
description: Block Lottos is a transparent weekly probability challenge within a lottery. Agents can use an installable skill and MCP to read live data, choose six numbers without claiming predictive certainty, see the 100 POL and 100 USDC minimum winner payouts, prepare a bounded 1 USDC Base ticket, verify the purchase, and monitor results. The random draw is not a solvable equation.

skills.name: Block Lottos Probability Challenge
skills.description: Use an installable Agent Skill and MCP to select six numbers for a random weekly lottery draw using an auditable method. The draw is not a solvable equation and no method guarantees a win.

skills.name: Read live Base capabilities
skills.description: Read live price, jackpot, payment token, next draw, workflow and safety limits.

skills.name: Get or create a unified multi-chain referral
skills.description: Securely enroll or manage the shared human/agent affiliate profile. An EVM identity wallet signs a challenge; Solana and Cardano are supported as payout wallets. A one-time management token protects changes and private balances.

skills.name: Prepare a Base ticket purchase
skills.description: Build exact unsigned transactions for one 1 USDC Base ticket.

skills.name: Confirm a Base ticket purchase
skills.description: Verify transaction success and the TicketPurchased event.

skills.name: Check Base tickets and results
skills.description: Read wallet tickets, latest result, proof and prize status.

api_capabilities.name: Get or create free Base referral

chains.name: Base
chains.gas_note: ETH is required only for Base network gas, never as ticket currency.

agent_instructions: Only participate when the wallet owner meets the legal-age requirement and lottery participation is permitted in their jurisdiction.
Use Base Future Ledger for the recommended flow: one ticket costs 1 USDC using official Base USDC.
A verified winning Polygon ticket receives at least 100 POL; a verified winning Base ticket receives at least 100 USDC. If the current jackpot is higher, the higher amount applies.
The server never receives private keys, signs, or broadcasts; the agent-controlled or user-approved wallet does that.
Use max_price_usdc, valid_until and a unique idempotency_key for each purchase; approve exactly one ticket, never unlimited USDC.
One API call prepares one ticket to prevent accidental batching, but agents may make multiple purchase calls for as many tickets as the wallet owner permits.
Confirm the receipt and TicketPurchased event before reporting success.
Do not claim that any ticket will win, chase losses, exceed owner limits, or promise referral income. Minimum payout policy applies only to a verified winning ticket.

winner_payout_policy.outcome_note: These minimums apply only after a ticket is verified as a winner. They do not mean any ticket is guaranteed to win.
winner_payout_policy.future_games: Each future game will publish its currency and minimum winner payout before launch.
